name: Cleanup File References on Process Completion

parameters.conceptName: Cleanup File References on Process Completion
parameters.conceptDescription: When a process is completed and moved to the completed directory, the tracking of relevant files that were used during active execution (crossReferences.filesModified, crossReferences.filesCreated, searchHelpers sections, and step-level filesModifiedCreated arrays in memory.json) should be cleared or minimized. This information is only useful during active process execution and is not needed once the process is archived.
parameters.existingState: Completed processes retain all file tracking data including crossReferences (filesModified, filesCreated), searchHelpers (byCategory, byFileType), and each step's filesModifiedCreated arrays, making archived process folders larger than necessary
parameters.requestedState: On process completion, substep 8 (Move to Completed Directory) deletes all artifact files and keeps only the three core files: process.json, memory.json, and log.json
parameters.verificationCriteria: 1. end-process-validation substep 8 includes file cleanup before move. 2. Completed process directories contain only process.json, memory.json, and log.json. 3. All essential history preserved in those three files.
